name: Napa Cabbage

companions.note: Compatible brassica bed; share crop rotation timing
Green onion deters soft-bodied pests from cabbage

pnw_notes: Mini varieties like Mini Napa #2 are perfect for small raised beds — full heads at half the footprint. Bolts readily in heat; fall is prime time. Extremely frost-tolerant — can hold in the ground well into December. Rich in vitamins, wonderful fresh or fermented as kimchi.

frost_hardiness.notes: Handles light frost; hard freeze damages outer wrapper leaves. Row cover below 28°F. Harvest before a sustained hard freeze.

planting_windows.notes: Sow 70–80 days before expected first frost for fall harvest
Transplant starts for more reliable fall timing
Harvest when heads feel firm; can hold in ground past first frosts
